description: Sven Teske and colleagues at the University of Technology Sydney Institute for Sustainable Futures report a technical and economic study of long-term energy and power development in Vietnam. The completed analysis combines GIS screening of solar and onshore/offshore wind potential, a long-term energy-scenario model, an eight-region hourly electricity-demand model and an open-source generation-cost optimisation tool. It assesses alternative pathways to inform the proposed eighth Power Development Plan. Zenodo supplies a report freely under CC BY 4.0; separate model packages are not identified in the inspected description. Coverage is national, with eight power-system regions and one-hour resolution for load analysis. The reported work is a planning study, not evidence that its preferred plan was adopted. A limitation is that scenario horizons, assumptions and model results were not checked from the report body. Related catalogue entries describe Vietnam generation assets and technology inputs, without proof that those exact deposits were used.
